description: This file contains the implementation of an AdmonitionRenderer class, which renders admonition blocks within a Markdown processing context for Confluence content formatting. It handles different admonition types and generates corresponding HTML elements.

classes.name: AdmonitionRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering admonition blocks in Markdown to Confluence compatible HTML content.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a given admonition node into an HTML element suitable for Confluence, setting the admonition type based on node type and including title and content.
